yazilar.baslik: Author denies allegations she used AI to write book after novel 'dropped by agent'
yazilar.ozet: Author Kathryn O’Connor Mertens has issued a statement denying allegations that she used artificial intelligence (AI) to write her novel Wild Horse Country, saying she has drafts, handwritten notes and research to demonstrate that she wrote the book herself.

yazilar.baslik: Tom Weldon outlines PRH action to government and staff in wake of Walliams allegations
yazilar.ozet: Penguin Random House CEO Tom Weldon has set out the company’s policies, measures and next steps around “bullying, harassment, sexual harassment and inappropriate behaviour, including protections against retaliation” in a letter seen by The Bookseller, sent to Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy and shared with staff today…

yazilar.baslik: Trade Interviews - Expert driven: Liz Gough of DK Living on putting experts front and centre
yazilar.ozet: DK Living’s Liz Gough on the expansion of the division’s cookery offering, changing non-fiction trends and the impact of artificial intelligence on the industry.

yazilar.baslik: Paper Sailor bags Chatsworth Bakehouse Cookbook as launch title
yazilar.ozet: Paper Sailor has acquired Chatsworth Bakehouse Cookbook by Sian Evans and Tom Mathews, founders of Chatsworth Bakehouse in Crystal Palace.

yazilar.baslik: Viking wins five-way auction for Jasper Nathaniel’s account of life in the West Bank
yazilar.ozet: Viking has acquired independent journalist Jasper Nathaniel’s How to Steal a Village, a "character-driven account of Israel’s large- and small-scale devastation of Palestinian life in the West Bank".
